book.title: 离婚后，前夫公司成了我的客户
book.description: 离婚后，独立设计师苏晚知凭专业方案接到前夫公司的业务邀请。她和团队面对盲评、材料质量危机与旧日关系，选择靠真实实力赢得事业和未来。

words.exampleEn: She calculated the time difference.

words.exampleEn: It was her choice to stay.

words.exampleZh: 两年来，她第一次能想象和姐姐共度未来的生活。

words.exampleEn: The report contained important information.

words.exampleEn: The manager asked for another safety test.

words.exampleEn: The product entered the market in autumn.
words.exampleZh: 这款产品于秋季进入市场。

words.exampleEn: The meeting began at ten o'clock.
words.exampleZh: 会议在十点开始。

words.exampleEn: A new message appeared on her phone.

words.exampleEn: The team built a small model before production.
words.exampleZh: 团队在生产前制作了一个小模型。

words.exampleEn: The money belonged to the company, not to him.
words.exampleZh: 这笔钱属于公司，而不是他个人。

words.exampleEn: I noticed a letter on the desk.

words.exampleEn: She arrived at the office before everyone else.
words.exampleZh: 她比其他人都早到办公室。

words.exampleEn: They considered another option.
words.exampleZh: 他们考虑了另一种选择。

words.exampleEn: Her business partner checked the budget.

words.exampleEn: She signed the final page with a black pen.
words.exampleZh: 她用一支黑色钢笔签署了最后一页。

words.exampleEn: Her phone rang during the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 她的手机在会议期间响了。

words.exampleEn: She sent a picture of the completed project.
words.exampleZh: 她发了一张已完成项目的照片。

words.exampleEn: They prepared a new plan for the project.

words.exampleEn: The new material increased the price.

words.exampleZh: 她信守了对姐姐的承诺。

words.exampleEn: The old record showed a different name.
words.exampleZh: 旧记录上写着另一个名字。

words.exampleEn: She regretted her angry words.
words.exampleZh: 她后悔自己说过的气话。

words.exampleEn: The engineer submitted a report on the test.
words.exampleZh: 工程师提交了一份测试报告。

words.exampleEn: She submitted a written request.
words.exampleZh: 她提交了一份书面申请。

words.exampleEn: He refused to respond to her question.
words.exampleZh: 他拒绝回答她的问题。

words.exampleEn: The final result surprised the judges.
words.exampleZh: 最终结果让评委们感到意外。

words.exampleEn: She knew the risk of trusting him.
words.exampleZh: 她知道信任他意味着风险。

words.exampleEn: She checked the maintenance schedule.
words.exampleZh: 她核对了维护时间表。

words.exampleEn: The results appeared on the large screen.
words.exampleZh: 结果显示在大屏幕上。

words.exampleEn: The signature was not hers.
words.exampleZh: 那个签名不是她的。

words.exampleEn: The new structure made the package stronger.
words.exampleZh: 新结构使包装更加结实。

words.exampleEn: The team discussed the risks together.
words.exampleZh: 团队一起讨论了风险。

words.exampleEn: She needed more time to review the document.
words.exampleZh: 她需要更多时间审核文件。

words.exampleEn: It was difficult to trust him again.
words.exampleZh: 再次信任他很困难。
